name: Air-Fryer Lauki Methi Muthiya
ingredients: 250 g lauki (bottle gourd), grated and lightly squeezed
¼ cup besan and ¼ cup whole-wheat flour
½ tsp each turmeric, ajwain and coriander powder
steps: Mix the lauki, methi, besan, flour, paste, spices, salt and lemon to a soft dough; add a spoon of flour if too wet.
Shape into 2 logs and steam for 15 minutes; cool and slice.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C, spray the slices and cook for 10 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Heat the oil, crackle the mustard seeds and toss the muthiya in it briefly.
note: Steaming first sets the muthiya; the air fryer then crisps the outside.
